temporal_state_chain.observed: Beverly tells John she admires how he handles the machines and says education is not just about degrees but about what one can do with what one knows.

temporal_state_chain.emotion: Valued, grateful, secure, and more self-assured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain transparency and open communication with Beverly.
